actual_config_and_conflicts.ownership: Single existing worker pinnedCPU1,nonreentrant generation/terminal poison. Try-acquire ADC1 then ADC2 SDK locks; ADC2 is required because helper cleanup clears its calibration too. Busy/second-lock failure releases only acquired locks and performs no helper/reset/clock writes. Claim/free ADC APB through pinned SDK API only after both locks. Hold neither RCC spinlock nor interrupt masking across helper/draw/UI. ADC reset-lock functions are empty,so not evidence of exclusivity. Static ADC/I2C counts have no public snapshot API; combine real API locks,closed call graph,readbacks and balanced own calls,never fabricate count0 from an app bool. Analog master is SHARED with PLL/MIPI clients: retain its SDK refcount behavior,never force it off or overwrite foreign count. Where observable,use periph_rcc_acquire_enter+exit as nonmutating count read,not acquire_exit. Changed/missing ownership or unexpected consumers refuses/poisons.
actual_config_and_conflicts.camera_LCD_touch_PMIC: Current LCD is BSP SPI2/ST7796 with asynchronous DMA/backlightLEDC,not S3 I80 or an assumed MIPI LCD. OV5647 uses CSI/ISP and SCCB on the BSP I2C handle; FT5x06 touch uses that external I2C bus and only navigates. Board PMIC/LDO/battery behavior remains existing profile; no on-chip battery ADC client or power reconfiguration is introduced. Compiled ADC/buttonADC/I2S/mbedTLS code alone is not a running consumer. Current helper/reset must not collide with an ADC client; camera/LDO may share analog master clock management,so exact linked callsites and before/after peripheral/GPIO/clock state must be reviewed rather than assuming separate names guarantee safety. Complete existing display ACK before collection; no display/I2C/PMIC reinit inside the lease. Existing camera/USB/tasks may continue; no scheduler freeze.
